thread:
maria: Quick sync — I'm consolidating ownership for the v2 deprecation rollouts. Need clarity on who owns SDK updates (TS + Py), infra proxy change, and the staging smoke failures. Can each owner confirm or volunteer?

alex: I can take TypeScript SDK updates. Working on PR #4123. ETA end of week unless tests fail.

jamal: Infra will need a config toggle in kube for the proxy header change. Blocked on secrets rotation approval (INF-987).

sophie: Docs volunteer here. Can someone list the concrete breaking behaviors we should call out in the migration guide? small checklist preferred.

kevin: On routing side: need fallback maps for older model variants. Also FYI staging smoke hit a repeatable failure on long sequences (~16k) with v2 endpoints. Repro steps below.

kevin: ```
cmd: curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"<long>...","max_tokens":16000}' 
resp: 502 gateway error, KV cache OOM in runtime logs
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment "v2-compat-check" started in us-west-2 (canary-3). Logs streaming: https://ci.internal/logs/9832

lisa: Suggest adding a client-side 'compat_mode' flag that defaults true. Gives us rollback path without infra flips.

alex: Will include compat_mode in TS SDK PR and add a small opt-out example.

jamal: If rotation approval is delayed >48h we should schedule a rollback window and freeze the proxy change. Requesting PM sign-off.

maria: Action items summary: Alex -> TS SDK (PR #4123) ETA EOW; Jamal -> infra toggle + INF-987; Sophie -> docs migration checklist; Kevin -> reproduce + post minimal test case; Lisa -> draft compat_mode UX; I will coordinate PM sign-off and calendar the rollback window if needed.

maria: Please ack with :thumbsup: and add an ETA if EOW is unrealistic.

alex: :thumbsup: ETA EOW for initial patch, follow-up next week for tests.

jamal: :thumbsup: ETA 48-72h once INF-987 approved.

sophie: :thumbsup: Draft checklist by tomorrow noon.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll post a minimal repro test by EOD and attach to the ticket.

lisa: :thumbsup: UX draft PR up in the morning.

maria: Thanks all — I'll ping PMs and infra execs for secrets rotation ASAP.
